# llms.txt — NemesisNet Brand Guide

NemesisNet Brand Guide is the production design system for NemesisNet, defining visual tokens, component rules, accessibility standards, and implementation guidance.

## Resources

- **Design System (Full):** https://brand.nemesisnet.co.za/DESIGN.md
- **Design System (Portable):** https://brand.nemesisnet.co.za/DESIGN-portable.md
- **Brand Tokens (CSS):** https://brand.nemesisnet.co.za/brand-tokens.css
- **Sitemap:** https://brand.nemesisnet.co.za/sitemap.xml

## Brand Assets

- **Logo (PNG):** https://brand.nemesisnet.co.za/assets/Nemesis_Logo_Icon.png
- **Logo (ICO):** https://brand.nemesisnet.co.za/assets/Nemesis_Logo_Icon.ico

## Tech Stack

- Static HTML/CSS served via nginx (alpine)
- Docker container: `nemesisguy/nemesisnet-brand-guide`
- No JavaScript frameworks — vanilla JS only
- Design tokens via CSS custom properties
